title: Introduction to Data Science in Economics and Business 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply R as a programming language and software for data analysis. Understand how to store, manage, process, and analyze data using R.
Apply supervised learning models to build data models for analyzing the impact of one variable on another or predicting a target variable.
Apply unsupervised learning models to build data models for classification, clustering, and data mining.
Develop skills in searching, processing, analyzing, transforming, and visualizing data using packages such as readr, readxl, dplyr, ggplot2, stringr.
Develop skills in building supervised learning models using R to understand and summarize data, analyze relationships between variables, or build predictive models.
Develop skills in building unsupervised learning models using R to explore, understand data, cluster data, find values within data, or detect outliers.
Develop the ability to learn independently, organize, and manage work in groups, synthesize issues, and persuade others.
Develop personal responsibility, responsibility towards the group, and build discipline in study.
